svg.title: Надежные фоновые задания с YDB и SQS
svg.desc: Архитектура отделяет прием бизнес-запроса от длительной фоновой работы.
svg.text: Надежные фоновые задания с YDB и SQS
External producer, relays and workers · SQS-compatible protocol inside YDB · two row-table transactions
Business data + Jobs + Outbox; no SQS enqueue
Topics are pub/sub logs with named YDB Consumers; SQS uses competing consumers and visibility.
Business/Jobs/Outbox commit first; CDC/relay performs a separate SQS enqueue.
SQS → Worker: claim/receive; Worker → SQS: ack/delete only after successful YDB commit.
No ack or visibility expiry retries the message; retry exhaustion moves it to SQS DLQ.
Queue delivery and external effects are not exactly-once processing.
